 *      to embed live, compile-tested samples while still shipping a fully–featured CLI utility.
 *
 *      If you are only interested in the prose guide, open this file in a Markdown-aware viewer.
 *      Everything outside of the C++ code-blocks (` ```cpp `) will be rendered as rich text.
 *
 *  Overview:
 *      The deployer is responsible for:
 *          • Loading deployment manifests written in YAML
 *          • Executing discrete deployment steps (pulling images, running migrations, etc.)
 *          • Streaming logs with optional ANSI colour
 *          • Performing health-checks against both REST and GraphQL gateways
 *          • Producing a machine-readable report (JSON) on completion
 *

 *      • yaml-cpp (https://github.com/jbeder/yaml-cpp)

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  Standard Library
// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#include <chrono>
#include <csignal>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>

// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#include <curl/curl.h>
#include <yaml-cpp/yaml.h>

#include "third_party/json.hpp"  // nlohmann::json single-header library

using json = nlohmann::json;
namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;

/**************************************************************************************************
 *  Logging Utility
 **************************************************************************************************/
enum class LogLevel { kInfo, kWarn, kError, kDebug };

class Logger
{
public:
    explicit Logger(bool use_colour = true, LogLevel threshold = LogLevel::kInfo)
        : _use_colour(use_colour), _threshold(threshold)
    {
    }

    void log(LogLevel lvl, const std::string &msg) const
    {
        if (static_cast<int>(lvl) < static_cast<int>(_threshold))
            return;

        std::ostream &out = (lvl == LogLevel::kError) ? std::cerr : std::cout;
        if (_use_colour)
            out << colour_code(lvl);

        out << "[" << label(lvl) << "] " << msg;

        if (_use_colour)
            out << "\033[0m";
        out << '\n';
    }

    void info(const std::string &msg) const { log(LogLevel::kInfo, msg); }
    void warn(const std::string &msg) const { log(LogLevel::kWarn, msg); }
    void error(const std::string &msg) const { log(LogLevel::kError, msg); }
    void debug(const std::string &msg) const { log(LogLevel::kDebug, msg); }

private:
    static std::string label(LogLevel lvl)
    {
        switch (lvl)
        {
        case LogLevel::kInfo: return "INFO";
        case LogLevel::kWarn: return "WARN";
        case LogLevel::kError: return "ERROR";
        case LogLevel::kDebug: return "DEBUG";
        default: return "UNKNOWN";
        }
    }

    static const char *colour_code(LogLevel lvl)
    {
        switch (lvl)
        {
        case LogLevel::kInfo: return "\033[32m";   // Green
        case LogLevel::kWarn: return "\033[33m";   // Yellow
        case LogLevel::kError: return "\033[31m";  // Red
        case LogLevel::kDebug: return "\033[36m";  // Cyan
        default: return "";
        }
    }

    bool     _use_colour;
    LogLevel _threshold;
};

/**************************************************************************************************
 *  Helper for libcurl HTTP GET requests (blocking, minimal)
 **************************************************************************************************/
static std::size_t curl_write_cb(void *contents, std::size_t size, std::size_t nmemb, void *userp)
{
    auto *s = static_cast<std::string *>(userp);
    s->append(static_cast<char *>(contents), size * nmemb);
    return size * nmemb;
}

class HttpClient
{
public:
    HttpClient()
    {
        curl_global_init(CURL_GLOBAL_DEFAULT);
        _curl = curl_easy_init();
        if (!_curl)
            throw std::runtime_error("Failed to initialize libcurl");
        // Generic settings
        curl_easy_setopt(_curl, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, 1L);
        curl_easy_setopt(_curl, CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION, curl_write_cb);
        curl_easy_setopt(_curl, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 10L);  // 10 seconds
    }

    ~HttpClient()
    {
        if (_curl)
            curl_easy_cleanup(_curl);
        curl_global_cleanup();
    }

    std::pair<long, std::string> get(const std::string &url)
    {
        std::string body;
        curl_easy_setopt(_curl, CURLOPT_URL, url.c_str());
        curl_easy_setopt(_curl, CURLOPT_WRITEDATA, &body);

        CURLcode res = curl_easy_perform(_curl);
        if (res != CURLE_OK)
            throw std::runtime_error("libcurl GET error: " + std::string(curl_easy_strerror(res)));

        long http_code = 0;
        curl_easy_getinfo(_curl, CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE, &http_code);

        return {http_code, body};
    }

private:
    CURL *_curl{nullptr};
};

/**************************************************************************************************
 *  Deployment Steps – Strategy Pattern
 **************************************************************************************************/
class DeploymentContext
{
public:
    explicit DeploymentContext(Logger &logger) : logger(logger) {}
    json results;

    Logger &logger;
    HttpClient http;  // re-use connection pool
};

class Step
{
public:
    virtual ~Step() = default;
    virtual std::string name() const                                          = 0;
    virtual void        run(DeploymentContext &ctx, const YAML::Node &node)   = 0;
};

/*─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *  Step: Pull Docker Image
 *───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────*/
class PullImageStep : public Step
{
public:
    std::string name() const override { return "pull_image"; }

    void run(DeploymentContext &ctx, const YAML::Node &node) override
    {
        const auto image = node["image"].as<std::string>();
        ctx.logger.info("Pulling Docker image: " + image);

        std::ostringstream cmd;
        cmd << "docker pull " << image;
        int rc = std::system(cmd.str().c_str());
        if (rc != 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("docker pull failed with code " + std::to_string(rc));

        ctx.results[name()] = {{"image", image}, {"status", "pulled"}};
    }
};

/*─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *  Step: Run Database Migration
 *───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────*/
class MigrationStep : public Step
{
public:
    std::string name() const override { return "db_migration"; }

    void run(DeploymentContext &ctx, const YAML::Node &node) override
    {
        const auto container = node["container"].as<std::string>();
        const auto command   = node["command"].as<std::string>();

        ctx.logger.info("Executing migration inside container: " + container);

        std::ostringstream cmd;
        cmd << "docker exec " << container << " " << command;
        int rc = std::system(cmd.str().c_str());
        if (rc != 0)
            throw std::runtime_error("Migration command failed with code " + std::to_string(rc));

        ctx.results[name()] = {{"container", container}, {"status", "migrated"}};
    }
};

/*─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *  Step: Health Check
 *───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────*/
class HealthCheckStep : public Step
{
public:
    std::string name() const override { return "health_check"; }

    void run(DeploymentContext &ctx, const YAML::Node &node) override
    {
        const auto url          = node["url"].as<std::string>();
        const auto expectedCode = node["expect"].as<int>(200);
        const auto retries      = node["retries"].as<int>(5);
        const auto intervalMs   = node["interval_ms"].as<int>(1000);

        ctx.logger.info("Performing health check: " + url);

        long  code   = 0;
        int   attempt = 0;
        bool  ok      = false;
        std::string body;

        while (attempt < retries)
        {
            std::tie(code, body) = ctx.http.get(url);
            if (code == expectedCode)
            {
                ok = true;
                break;
            }

            ctx.logger.warn("Healthcheck attempt " + std::to_string(attempt + 1) +
                            " failed (HTTP " + std::to_string(code) + "), retrying…");
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(intervalMs));
            ++attempt;
        }

        if (!ok)
            throw std::runtime_error("Service did not become healthy: " + url);

        ctx.results[name()] =
            {{"url", url}, {"status", "healthy"}, {"attempts", attempt + 1}, {"http_code", code}};
    }
};

/**************************************************************************************************
 *  Deployment Plan Parser & Executor
 **************************************************************************************************/
class DeploymentPlan
{
public:
    explicit DeploymentPlan(Logger &logger) : _ctx(logger)
    {
        // Register builtin steps
        register_step(std::make_unique<PullImageStep>());
        register_step(std::make_unique<MigrationStep>());
        register_step(std::make_unique<HealthCheckStep>());
    }

    void load_manifest(const fs::path &manifest_path)
    {
        if (!fs::exists(manifest_path))
            throw std::runtime_error("Manifest file not found: " + manifest_path.string());

        _doc = YAML::LoadFile(manifest_path.string());
    }

    void execute()
    {
        if (!_doc)
            throw std::runtime_error("Deployment manifest not loaded");

        for (const auto &stepNode : _doc)
        {
            const auto stepName = stepNode["step"].as<std::string>();
            auto *     step     = step_by_name(stepName);

            if (!step)
                throw std::runtime_error("Unknown deployment step: " + stepName);

            _ctx.logger.info("---------------------------------------------");
            _ctx.logger.info("Running step: " + stepName);
            const auto t0 = Clock::now();

            step->run(_ctx, stepNode);

            const auto duration =
                std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(Clock::now() - t0).count();
            _ctx.logger.info("Step '" + stepName + "' completed in " + std::to_string(duration) +
                             " ms");
        }
    }

    json report() const
    {
        json rpt;
        rpt["timestamp"] = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
                               Clock::now().time_since_epoch())
                               .count();
        rpt["results"] = _ctx.results;
        return rpt;
    }

private:
    void register_step(std::unique_ptr<Step> step)
    {
        _steps.emplace(step->name(), std::move(step));
    }

    Step *step_by_name(const std::string &name)
    {
        const auto it = _steps.find(name);
        return (it != _steps.end()) ? it->second.get() : nullptr;
    }

    std::map<std::string, std::unique_ptr<Step>> _steps;
    YAML::Node                                   _doc;
    DeploymentContext                            _ctx;
};

/**************************************************************************************************
 *  Signal Handling (graceful Ctrl-C)
 **************************************************************************************************/
static volatile std::sig_atomic_t g_interrupted = 0;
void                                signal_handler(int) { g_interrupted = 1; }

/**************************************************************************************************
 *  CLI – main()
 **************************************************************************************************/
int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    Logger logger(true, LogLevel::kInfo);

    if (argc < 2)
    {
        logger.error("Usage: studio-deployer <manifest.yml> [--json-report]");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    const fs::path manifest{argv[1]};
    const bool     json_output =
        (argc >= 3 && std::string_view(argv[2]) == std::string_view("--json-report"));

    // Register Ctrl-C
    std::signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);

    try
    {
        DeploymentPlan plan(logger);
        plan.load_manifest(manifest);

        logger.info("====== PaletteFlux Studio Deployer ======");
        logger.info("Manifest: " + manifest.string());

        plan.execute();

        logger.info("Deployment succeeded!");
        const auto rpt = plan.report();

        if (json_output)
        {
            std::cout << "\n" << rpt.dump(4) << std::endl;
        }
    }
    catch (const std::exception &ex)
    {
        logger.error(std::string("Deployment failed: ") + ex.what());
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (g_interrupted)
        logger.warn("Execution interrupted by user");

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
